t: 10.15 p.m., in a store, 252-253, North Soochow Road. Extinguished by occupants. No general alarm given. Origin unknown.

4 a.m., at a Livery Stable in Hoopeh Road, opposite the Parsee Cemetery. 3 houses burnt and 1 pulled down. General alarm given. Brigade attended. Caused by a candle falling among some straw in the stable.
3 a.m., at corner of Sunkiang and Kuangse Roads. General alarm given. Brigade attended. 2 one-storied houses burnt. Origin supposed to have been from a lamp left burning in a room having straw in it.
12 noon, at 465, Canton Road. Bed burnt. No general alarm given. Caused by a candle setting fire to the bed curtains.
5 p.m. A straw house in Lee Hongkew village. Burnt down. No general alarm given. Origin unknown.

8.30 p.m. At a house being built in the Nankin Road, near the Bund (behind E. D. Sassoon & Co.'s). General alarm given. A quantity of worked up material more or less burned, building not injured. Originated probably from some workmen smoking, and setting fire to shavings.
4.35 a.m., in godown and coal shed China Merchants' Wharf, Hongkew. General alarm given. Godown and contents burnt. Origin unknown.
12 midnight, at 48, Canton Road (in an alley near the Honan Road). General alarm given. 7 houses burnt. Origin unknown.

7.35 p.m., at 586, Canton Road (in an alley near Rothwell, Love & Co.'s old premises). General alarm given. 1 house burnt, 2 partially burnt. Origin, fire in a cooking stove setting fire to the cook house.

2.40 p.m. the cook house and boys' quarters at 17, Pekin Road (Hyde, Hertz & Co.'s). General alarm given. Cook house and boys' quarters burnt down. Caused by a rafter which was built in the cook house chimney catching fire.
2.30 a.m., in a carpenter's shop in Lee Hongkew village. No general alarm given. 3 small houses burnt and 2 damaged. Put out by police and neighbours. Origin unknown.
1 p.m. An ice house in country near Bamboo Town. Burnt down. No general alarm given. Origin unknown.
3.15 a.m., at 1099a, Broadway (corner of Minghong Road). General alarm given. 5 houses burnt. A Chinese boy aged 13, burnt.
11 p.m., at 180, Hankow Road. A newly built empty house. Put out by neighbours. No General alarm given. Probably set on fire.
4 a.m., at 69, Canton Road. A child dropped a match in a tin of kerosine oil which ignited and ran out on the floor. Put out by a foreign constable and others. No general alarm given.
3 a.m. At a paper shop in Fuhkien Road, near the Chinese theatre. General alarm given. 66 houses burnt and 7 houses pulled down. Origin, explosion of a kerosine lamp.
12 midnight, 254, Woosieh Road. No general alarm given. Woodwork front of house partially burnt. Origin unknown. Empty house, supposed to have been set on fire wilfully.
3.25 a.m., at 135, Woochang Road (a Bakery). General alarm given. The contents of a room over the oven burnt. Origin, a defective chimney.
11 p.m., a stack of reeds at back of 487A, Broadway Road. General alarm given. No damage to any buildings. Origin unknown.
4.30 a.m., a thatched house in the Lee Hongkew village. No general alarm given. Roof burnt, put out by Police and neighbours. Origin unknown, probably wilfully set on fire.
10.30 p.m., 400M, (near H.B.M.'s Gaol). No general alarm given. Woodwork of the back of the house partially burnt. Empty house, door open. Origin of fire unknown, probably set on fire.
5 a.m., at 354, Lee Hongkew village. No general alarm given. Bed and bedding burnt, put out by inmates. Origin, upsetting a lamp which set the bed on fire.
11.30 p.m., at a house in Chefoo Road. No general alarm given, part of ceiling burnt, caused by a stove pipe setting fire to some woodwork near it.
4 p.m., at 121, Hankow Road. General alarm given. The Verandah and part of the roof of house burnt, put out by inmates and neighbours. Origin, a chimney built under the floor of the verandah.
10.45 p.m., at a house in Amoy Road, near H.B.M.'s Gaol. General alarm given. Roof of cook house and part of house burnt, put out with extincteurs. Origin unknown.
11.45 p.m., at 700, Pekin Road. No general alarm was given. Front of house (woodwork) slightly burned. Origin, supposed wilfully set on fire.
12.10 a.m., a large buffaloe shed off the Broadway Road (in the country). General alarm given. The sheds and 3 buffaloes burnt. Origin of fire unknown.
